title: 菊花賞の後に・青空は遠くとも

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I couldn't make it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh well… I guess I had fun.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whooooaaa!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I think I just fell in love with Seiun Sky! I had no idea she was so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: She could cause a serious uproar in her senior year!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Seiun Skyyy! Show us more races like that in the future!
The cheers, the applause, the roaring excitement… Everyone had their eyes on Seiun Sky, even more than on the actual winner.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wonder what woulda happened if I'd won.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha! Guess that means next time I gotta—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Great job out there! You were incredible!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Thank you. You too, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I want to run with you again! Let's keep being rivals next year!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh. That's a little presumptuous of ya, but sure. Let's race again!
The two rivals show their mutual respect for making it through the Classics. And as the curtains close on the Kikuka Sho, the crowd explodes with cheers at the sight of this beautiful scene.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer… Guess I wasn't good enough for the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: But you worked hard for it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're right, I really did work hard. This just goes to show I'm not a strong Umamusume.
choice_data_list: But you really wowed the audience.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh… I guess so. Maybe I was pretty fun to watch?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, and did you see the look on Spe's face?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She still hasn't had her fill! She's gonna make me work myself to the bone all over again.
Sky smiles bitterly as she says this, but at the same time, she seems to be enjoying herself.
On our way home from the race, Sky is surrounded by a large number of fans.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Seiun Sky! That was an amazing race today!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see you in the Arima Kinen! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen? Am I running in that?
The year-end Grand Prix—the Arima Kinen… Many set this race as a goal, but Seiun Sky hasn't given it any thought yet.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Oh… I figured since you did so great today, well, the next one would be a given…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: With this momentum, you can beat Grass Wonder and prove that you're the top of your generation!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohh, so Grass is gonna be there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I see… The top of my generation, huh…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's a good enough reason for me. Guess I'm running in the Arima Kinen then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's not like I had anything else in mind. This works out pretty great.
choice_data_list: The other racers are the best of the bunch. Are you sure you can handle that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wow, how can you say that? After we just went for the Triple Crown together, no less! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Things'll work themselves out, just like they always have.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And I have a feeling something really cool is gonna happen. ♪
As simply as that, Sky's fans have talked her into her next goal… the Arima Kinen!
